Loss report: woodpecker -> forgejo
[emulated] pipeline/woodpecker job.if: !github.event.deleted on every job (GitHub Actions runs a push workflow when a branch is deleted and the source starts no run for that; each job condition ends with the guard)
[emulated] pipeline/woodpecker pipeline.concurrency: concurrency group per run (Forgejo cancels earlier push and pull_request runs while concurrency is unset; the source had no concurrency, so each run gets its own group)
[emulated] pipeline/woodpecker pipeline.finally: job with if: always() that needs every other job
[emulated] pipeline/woodpecker/job/build job.runner: default runner label ubuntu-latest (the IR holds no runner label)
[emulated] pipeline/woodpecker/job/build step.action: actions/checkout step (Woodpecker clones the repository before the steps (https://woodpecker-ci.org/docs/usage/workflow-syntax); the depth and recursive settings of the clone map to the step inputs, and GHA does not clone)
[emulated] pipeline/woodpecker/job/build/step/build step.image: uses: docker://<image> with entrypoint and args
[emulated] pipeline/woodpecker/job/notify job.runner: default runner label ubuntu-latest (the IR holds no runner label)
[emulated] pipeline/woodpecker/job/notify step.action: actions/checkout step (Woodpecker clones the repository before the steps (https://woodpecker-ci.org/docs/usage/workflow-syntax); the depth and recursive settings of the clone map to the step inputs, and GHA does not clone)
[emulated] pipeline/woodpecker/job/notify/step/notify step.image: uses: docker://<image> with entrypoint and args
[emulated] pipeline/woodpecker/trigger/0 trigger.push: branches: '**' (GHA fires a push without filters for branches and tags; branches are named explicitly to leave tags out or beside a tag filter)
[native] pipeline/woodpecker/job/build/synth/checkout step.action (printed as an absolute URL; an instance that cannot reach https://github.com needs the URL edited)
[native] pipeline/woodpecker/job/notify/synth/checkout step.action (printed as an absolute URL; an instance that cannot reach https://github.com needs the URL edited)
